$Comment: The Objective Book. Holding it and using it opens a two-tab menu of this server's quests and achievements, with per-player progress, and lets a player take on an offered quest or collect a finished one. Nothing hands the book out on its own: give one with /give <player> Ziggfreed_Objective_Book --quantity=1 (the count is read ONLY from --quantity, a bare number after the id is ignored), or author it as a quest, shop, or loot reward. When another mod on this server runs its own quests and achievements, the book opens to a short line pointing the player at that mod's own menus instead. The art is the vanilla brown grimoire; point Icon / Model / Texture somewhere else to reskin it, or override this file by id to retune anything here.
